entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  MACD divergence (1d) = hidden bullish -> +35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  distance to EMA20 = +3.77% -> -23 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,484.49 vs EMA20 2,394.31
  Bollinger position = 63% of band -> -21 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  resistance proximity = 23.0% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI daily = 62.8 -> -9 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI 1h = 50.4 -> +6 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (8.5) = +0.5 -> WAIT
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
